# Budget the Portal theme spec in Engine E2E sharding

## Context

Task Worker PR #21900 at `4b95961f` twice reported `93 passed (6.1m)` on shard 15 before Actions stopped the test step at six minutes. The aggregate required check then failed. The new Task Worker spec passed in 12.2 seconds on shard 5. [First attempt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45042064059/job/137269005743) · [Retry](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45042064059/job/137273030260)

## The Problem

`ExamplesCatalogTheme.spec.mjs` was absent from the timing table. Its 32.6-second fallback underestimated a 67.7-second hosted observation. Adding that row improved the original replay, then shifted the overrun to shard 1 on #21978. That shard reported all 82 tests passing before the same six-minute cap. Board Big Data and the standalone examples theme switcher took 59.6 and 43.6 seconds, with both still using the fallback. [Timing PR timeout](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45044962723/job/137277517486)

## The Architectural Reality

`buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` reads per-file observations from `buildScripts/util/e2eEngineDurations.json`. Its balancer assigns each selected file once using those costs. `test.yml` keeps a six-minute PR test step. The Task Worker dynamically loads its custom task entry and still needs full-tier coverage under the existing classifier.

Design authority: the existing duration planner assigns engine specs using measured file costs. This refreshes measured observations within that planner.

## The Fix

Refresh the existing table from the Task Worker run and retry, the timing PR's full run, and the corresponding full `dev` run. Retain prior per-file maxima when they exceed the newer observations. Preserve the 15-way matrix, selected files, assertions, and six-minute limit.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Replay the three logged populations before and after the refresh, verifying every selected file is assigned exactly once. Report the slowest modeled shard and the hosted result on the refreshed timing PR.
- [x] Run the existing E2E selection tests.
- [x] Post-merge, #21900 at `468c07cd24` passed all 15 E2E shards. Shard 15 took 324 seconds and the slowest shard took 341 seconds. [Task Worker run](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45047980334)

## Out of Scope

Changes to shard count, timeout, test coverage, runtime imports, and automatic table refresh.

## Related

#21900, #21287, #21493, #21771.

Live sweep at 16:33 UTC on 22 November: latest 20 open issues, open and closed timing-table searches, existing Euclid assignments, recent A2A claims, and Memory Core prior art. The prior planner issues are closed and their scope exclusions allow this measured data correction. The live search returned 74 open issues. No open repair or competing claim matched this spec.
